hosting.operationalLogs: GitHub Pages logs and stores visitors' IP addresses for security purposes, including signed-out visitors. GitHub controls its hosting/security processing and retention under its privacy statement; we do not promise a fixed deletion period for GitHub's logs.

support.authorizedAccess: Tom Cocozzello is the only person with access to the support inbox. The email service provider processes messages as described in its privacy information.
support.retention: We retain support correspondence only as long as reasonably necessary to address requests and meet applicable legal obligations. We periodically review retained messages and delete or anonymize information no longer needed.
